[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/e0c639fcf58d2627403d2df426ec0917fb58be3a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/726f807df737e46f91dd8eeba2a6a20fcec903af.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/726f807df737e46f91dd8eeba2a6a20fcec903af.png[/img]


This is all building to a [b]BIG announcement at the end of the month[/b] so keep an eye out! 
(No rhyme this week. Dr. Dryspell is MIA)

Cheers,
The Unbound Creations Team

notes.title: First Week is Full of Updates! (Patch Notes)
notes.content:
First of all, a[b] BIG THANK YOU to everyone who has submitted bugs to us!!![/b] You guys are awesome and helping us make Rain on Your Parade the best game it could be!

We definitely stayed busy fixing and tweaking as much as we could. You might have not noticed, but we've actually been update the Steam build [i]every night![/i] I think this is the first night when we're actually not pushing a new update (hopefully a good sign we fixed everything?) 

[h2]Here's the Patch Notes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Re-designed the penultimate Seattle Defense level to speed it up and make it less tedious to re-play
[*] Fixed an exploit where you could unlock some achievements without actually doing the things you need to do (sorry!)
[*] Clarified some objective names and added hints to make some levels less confusing
[*] Improved face drawing smoothing when brush size is smol
[*] Added nicer background to Cardboard Gear Cloud (since so many of you enjoyed taking photos there!)
[*] A few quality-of-life and difficulty tweaks (like guards on Cardboard Gear Cloud having slightly shorter sight distance)
[*] Fixed a bunch of places where you could clip out of the world (particularly the Cloudbuster Canyon)
[*] Added "Join our Newsletter" button to main menu like the shameless self-promoting clouds we are
[*] Replaced some older decors with brand new, flashier ones!
[*] Fixed a bug in Weatherman Goes to Work that could cause cars not to appear
[*] Fixed missing collisions on some objects
[*] Bunch of other minor fixes we forgot!
[/list]

[i](if you're playing on consoles, don't worry - you got all the critical updates already, and anything left is coming soon as well!)[/i]

[h2]What's Next? YOU Tell us![/h2]

We're exploring our options, but we'd really LOVE to hear from you! We got a little 2-minute survey going: 

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfdtT2vSy87exV4nXeriGI3bD7bv1PVaThyH5td2ldDI_S0Qw/viewform

We'd appreciate your feedback!

[h2]Help us Spread the Word[/h2]

If you enjoyed the game, you'd be doing us a big help if you'd mention it to your favorite streamers and Youtubers :) We've been sending tons of emails (SO MANY EMAILS) but at the end of the day, nothing works better than some good old word-of-mouth! And who wouldn't believe such amazing folks as yourselves ;D 


Anyway, that's it for the current update! More to come, I am sure, as well as new goodies and content like merch or DLC :O 

Cheers,
Jakub
Lead Dev 
On Behalf of Unbound Creations Team

notes.title: Big Demo Update: polish, new character, AND potato mode!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

First of all, thank you for following the game thus far :) We're doing really well on development and hitting all our milestones! We're already looking at the weather calendar for next year to find the rainiest day possible.

While working on the main game, we're doing a lot of polish and tweaks on existing elements, so it makes sense to update the demo as well! 

[h2]Latest update include, among others:[/h2]

[h3][b]Fancy animated UI [/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/381782ed6aebbc2843c504577c4b015f125c6ce7.gif[/img]

[h3][b]New character[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/c3a2102b40a516e475663704abc2a0ead8c96945.gif[/img]

[h3][b]New "Potato" graphical quality level - it looks like trash, it runs like a dream![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/d2e464dd9af6c3875c733d18e96028f33a862395.jpg[/img]

(Note: Potato mode is experimental low-fidelity graphics setting intended only for lowest performing computers. Some effects, like transparency, may not display properly) 

[h3][b]Reworked some scenes to make them livelier[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/8a20d8ddb95796d4589011a645d2e2c7a3747cc1.gif[/img]

For instance on Beach, instead of just standing awkwardly, some folks will now dance and play around, others lie down and sun bathe. And on the wedding, the bride actually WALKS UP to the altar now! (are we next gen or what??)

[h3][b]Improved lighting on the Overworld[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/02e475b1a834f23f1754f439dbd0cc054add62a0.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]...and many more other bug fixes and minor tweaks![/b][/h3]

If you re-play the demo, let us know what you think. And keep your eyes open for another announcement coming later this week ;) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/d93f6decf5b84c31f16303341a90ccee8704732b.jpg[/img]

Cheers,
Jakub
Founder & Creative Director
[i]On Behalf of the Unbound Creations Team[/i]

Maybe we should have a photo contest down the line 🤔 Let us know what you think!?

notes.title: 2000 Demo downloads + Update!
notes.content:
We released the demo for the game a week ago and [b]just passed 2,000 downloads[/b] 🤯😱 

[b]Thank YOU[/b] for playing, tweeting about it, making Let's Plays, and telling your friends/cat!

With that, I think it's good time to push[b] an update to our demo build featuring TON of bug fixes and optimizations[/b] for a certain console we may have been hinting at ;) The demo should run a bit better and have less spikes now. We're not done with all the optimization work just yet tho, don't worry.

Big kudos to everyone reporting bugs and giving suggestions [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1213230/discussions/]on our forum[/url]. Also special thanks to Pyrian from [url=https://discord.gg/Zz3eD5Q]our Discord[/url] who has been re-playing the demo to death and reporting a ton of additional bugs! You guys are the real MVPs🥳

As for a sneak-peek at some of the new levels we're working on for the full game... did you ever wonder what would happen if you could rain bread?

[previewyoutube=2t_GFUQFT3s;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks for reading and playing, stay tuned for more exciting news from us!
